raw_response:
Yes. There is one genuinely structural, bridge-doable step left, but it is narrow and should be treated as a final spectral sanity check, not as a new open-ended mining program.
The single best step is:
Test whether public genetic-code lability lives in the canonical  $H_3=E_3$  three-coordinate interaction subspace after all one- and two-coordinate composition structure is fixed.
This uses only the 27 public NCBI genetic codes and the already certified  $V_4^3$  spectral structure. It does not need omics, translation parameters, private  $d_{\rm resid4}$ , or amino-acid property data.
Exact object
Let codon space be

$$X=V_4^3,$$

with the canonical chemical-character Fourier decomposition

$$\mathbb{R}^{64}=E_0\oplus E_1\oplus E_2\oplus E_3,$$

where  $E_3$  is the top Krawtchouk eigenspace of  $H(3,4)$ , eigenvalue  $\lambda=-3$ .
Define the public alternative-code lability set

$$R=\{c\in X:\text{codon }c\text{ is assigned differently from the standard code in at least one of the 27 NCBI codes}\}.$$

You already have  $|R|=13$ . Let

$$f_R=\mathbf{1}_R-\frac{|R|}{64}\mathbf{1}.$$

The invariant is the top-spectral lability energy

$$T_{H3}(R)=\|P_{E_3}f_R\|_2^2.$$

Equivalently, this asks whether the reassigned-codon locus is unusually concentrated in the pure three-coordinate interaction layer, not merely in first-position, second-position, third-position, box, wobble, or pairwise composition structure.
Exact null
Use the strongest composition-preserving null:

$$\Omega_{2\text{-marg}}(R)
=
\{S\subset X: |S|=13,\ M_{12}(S)=M_{12}(R),\ M_{13}(S)=M_{13}(R),\ M_{23}(S)=M_{23}(R)\}.$$

Here  $M_{ij}(S)$  is the full  $4\times4$  pairwise marginal table for positions  $i,j$ . This fixes:


the first-two-position box profile;


every position-pair composition profile;


the third-position/wobble distribution conditional on each other position;


all Fourier coefficients supported on at most two codon coordinates.


In the  $V_4^3$  Fourier language, fixing all pairwise marginals fixes the  $E_0$ ,  $E_1$ , and  $E_2$  content. The only remaining spectral freedom is genuinely  $E_3$ .
The pre-registered p-value is

$$p_{H3}
=
\Pr_{S\sim\Omega_{2\text{-marg}}}
\left[
\|P_{E_3}f_S\|_2^2
\ge
\|P_{E_3}f_R\|_2^2
\right].$$

If exact enumeration of  $\Omega_{2\text{-marg}}$  is feasible, use exact enumeration. If not, use a fixed-seed Markov basis or switch chain on binary  $4\times4\times4$  tables with fixed two-dimensional marginals, and report it as Monte Carlo.
Why this escapes reduction
It is not  $e_{\rm in}$ : no synonymous-edge count enters the statistic or the null.
It is not ordinary composition: all one- and two-coordinate composition information is fixed. In fact, this null is stronger than box/wobble preservation because it fixes every pairwise coordinate shadow.
It is not a count match:  $|R|=13$  is fixed in every null sample and cannot produce significance.
It is not q6-circular in the bad sense: it uses the independently certified  $V_4^3$  chemical-character structure of codon space, not a Window6 or Zeckendorf embedding.
It is not a private bio-data test: the only biological input is the public finite list of codons reassigned in NCBI genetic codes.
Interpretation
If  $R$  is extreme for  $T_{H3}$ , then the new spectral direction gets one more purely structural bridge fact:
natural code lability is not merely box/wobble/composition-local; it occupies the canonical highest-frequency three-coordinate layer.
That would make  $H_3$  a plausible public-code-variation axis before touching  $d_{\rm resid4}$ . It still would not certify the  $H_3\leftrightarrow d_{\rm resid4}$  biological gate. It would only say that the public evolutionary reassignment locus already sees  $H_3$ .
If  $R$  is typical under  $\Omega_{2\text{-marg}}$ , then the answer becomes clean:
bridge is correctly bio-gated; the decisive next input is  $d_{\rm resid4}$ .
No further structural mining should continue after that failure.
The sharpest next question is: After fixing all pairwise codon-coordinate marginals of the 13 public reassigned codons, is their  $E_3$  spectral energy still extreme, or does the apparent H3 signal collapse into box/wobble composition?
